name: create_category
description: Create a new category for channels

name: delete_category
description: Delete a category

name: edit_category
description: Edit a category (rename or move position)

name: find_category
description: Find a category ID using name and server ID

name: list_channels_in_category
description: List of channels in a specific category

name: list_channel_permission_overwrites
description: Returns all permission overwrites for a channel with role/member breakdown and allow/deny details

name: upsert_role_channel_permissions
description: Creates or updates permission overwrite for a role on a channel

params.name: allowPermissions
params.description: Allow permissions as CSV of names (e.g. VIEW_CHANNEL,MESSAGE_SEND)

params.name: denyPermissions
params.description: Deny permissions as CSV of names (e.g. MESSAGE_SEND,MANAGE_MESSAGES)

name: upsert_member_channel_permissions
description: Creates or updates permission overwrite for a member on a channel

params.name: allowPermissions
params.description: Allow permissions as CSV of names (e.g. VIEW_CHANNEL,VOICE_CONNECT)

params.name: denyPermissions
params.description: Deny permissions as CSV of names (e.g. MESSAGE_SEND,VOICE_SPEAK)

name: delete_channel_permission_overwrite
description: Deletes a permission overwrite for a role or member from a channel

name: delete_channel
description: Delete a channel

name: create_text_channel
description: Create a new text channel

name: find_channel
description: Find a channel type and ID using name and server ID

name: list_channels
description: List of all channels

name: edit_text_channel
description: Edit settings of a text channel (name, topic, nsfw, slowmode, category, position)

params.name: categoryId
params.description: Category ID (empty to remove from category)

name: get_channel_info
description: Get detailed information about a channel

name: move_channel
description: Move a channel to another category and/or change its position

params.name: categoryId
params.description: Target category ID (empty to remove from category)

name: get_server_info
description: Get detailed discord server information

name: list_emojis
description: List all custom emojis on the server

name: get_emoji_details
description: Get detailed information about a specific custom emoji

name: create_emoji
description: Upload a new custom emoji to the server. Provide image as base64 (Data URI or raw) OR a direct image URL. Max 256KB

params.name: name
params.description: Emoji name (2-32 chars, alphanumeric and underscores only)

params.name: image
params.description: Image as base64 Data URI (e.g. data:image/png;base64,...) or raw base64 string

params.name: imageUrl
params.description: Direct URL to the image file (alternative to base64 image)

params.name: roles
params.description: Comma-separated role IDs to restrict emoji usage (empty = everyone)

name: edit_emoji
description: Edit an existing emoji's name or role restrictions

params.name: emojiId
params.description: ID of the emoji to edit

params.name: roles
params.description: Comma-separated role IDs to restrict usage (empty string = unrestrict for everyone)

name: delete_emoji
description: Permanently delete a custom emoji from the server

params.name: emojiId
params.description: ID of the emoji to delete

name: create_forum_channel
description: Create a new forum channel

params.name: slowmode
params.description: Default slowmode for new posts in seconds (0-21600)

name: edit_forum_channel
description: Edit settings of a forum channel (name, topic, nsfw, slowmode, category, position, default sort, default layout)

params.name: slowmode
params.description: Default slowmode for new posts in seconds (0-21600)

params.name: categoryId
params.description: Category ID (empty to remove from category)

params.name: defaultSort
params.description: Default sort order: RECENT_ACTIVITY or CREATION_TIME

name: list_forum_channels
description: List all forum channels in the server

name: get_forum_channel_info
description: Get detailed information about a forum channel including tags and settings

name: list_forum_tags
description: List all available tags in a forum channel

name: create_forum_post
description: Create a new forum post (thread) with an initial message in a forum channel

name: list_forum_posts
description: List active posts (threads) in a forum channel

name: modify_forum_post
description: Modify a forum post: lock/unlock, archive/unarchive, pin/unpin, or change applied tags

params.name: tagIds
params.description: Comma-separated tag IDs to set (empty string to clear)

name: create_invite
description: Create a new invite link for a specific channel

params.name: channelId
params.description: ID of the channel the invite directs to

params.name: maxAge
params.description: Duration in seconds before expiry (0 = never, default 86400 = 24h)

params.name: maxUses
params.description: Max number of uses (0 = unlimited, default 0)

params.name: temporary
params.description: Whether members get temporary membership (kicked when disconnected unless role assigned)

params.name: unique
params.description: Force creation of a new unique invite code

name: list_invites
description: List all active invites on the server with their statistics

name: delete_invite
description: Delete (revoke) an invite so the link stops working

params.name: inviteCode
params.description: Invite code or full URL (e.g. 'ABCde' or 'https://discord.gg/ABCde')

name: get_invite_details
description: Get details about a specific invite (works for any public invite)

params.name: inviteCode
params.description: Invite code or full URL (e.g. 'ABCde' or 'https://discord.gg/ABCde')

params.name: withCounts
params.description: Whether to include approximate member counts (default true)

name: send_message
description: Send a message to a specific channel

name: edit_message
description: Edit a message from a specific channel

name: delete_message
description: Delete a message from a specific channel

name: read_messages
description: Read message history from a specific channel, optionally paginated with before/after/around

params.name: before
params.description: Message ID to fetch messages before this message

params.name: after
params.description: Message ID to fetch messages after this message

params.name: around
params.description: Message ID to fetch messages around this message

name: add_reaction
description: Add a reaction (emoji) to a specific message

name: remove_reaction
description: Remove a specified reaction (emoji) from a message

name: get_attachment
description: Get attachment metadata (filename, size, content type, URLs) from a specific message. Returns info only, does not download files.

params.name: attachmentId
params.description: Specific attachment ID (omit to get all attachments)

name: kick_member
description: Kicks a member from the server. The user can rejoin with a new invite.

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the user to kick

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for kicking (visible in audit log)

name: ban_member
description: Bans a user from the server, preventing them from rejoining. Optionally deletes their recent messages.

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the user to ban

params.name: deleteMessageSeconds
params.description: Duration in seconds for which to delete the user's messages (max 604800 = 7 days). 0 = no deletion.

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for the ban (visible in audit log)

name: unban_member
description: Removes a ban from a user, allowing them to rejoin the server.

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the user to unban

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for removing the ban (visible in audit log)

name: timeout_member
description: Disables communication for a member for a specified duration (Timeout/Mute). Max 28 days.

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the member to timeout

params.name: durationSeconds
params.description: Duration of the timeout in seconds (max 2419200 = 28 days)

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for the timeout (visible in audit log)

name: remove_timeout
description: Removes a timeout (unmute) from a member before it expires.

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the member to remove timeout from

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for removing the timeout (visible in audit log)

name: set_nickname
description: Changes a member's nickname on the server. Pass empty or null nick to reset to original username.

params.name: nick
params.description: New nickname. Empty or null to reset to original username.

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for the nickname change (visible in audit log)

name: get_bans
description: Returns a list of banned users on the server with ban reasons.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50)

name: list_roles
description: Returns a list of all roles on the server along with their ID, names, colors, positions, and permissions

name: create_role
description: Creates a new role on the server with specified parameters

params.name: color
params.description: Color value as integer (e.g., 16711680 for red). Default is 0

params.name: hoist
params.description: Whether the role should be displayed separately in the sidebar. Default is false

params.name: mentionable
params.description: Whether the role should be mentionable. Default is false

params.name: permissions
params.description: Permissions bitfield for the role as string. Default is 0

name: edit_role
description: Updates settings of an existing role. All parameters except guild_id and role_id are optional

params.name: roleId
params.description: ID of the role to edit

name: delete_role
description: Permanently deletes a role from the server

params.name: roleId
params.description: ID of the role to delete

name: assign_role
description: Assigns a specified role to a user

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the user to receive the role

params.name: roleId
params.description: ID of the role to assign

name: remove_role
description: Removes a specified role from a user

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the user from whom to remove the role

params.name: roleId
params.description: ID of the role to remove

name: create_guild_scheduled_event
description: Schedule a new event on the server (voice, stage, or external)

params.name: scheduledStartTime
params.description: ISO8601 timestamp for when the event starts

params.name: scheduledEndTime
params.description: ISO8601 timestamp for when the event ends (Required for External events)

params.name: location
params.description: Location or link (Required for type 3 - External)

name: edit_guild_scheduled_event
description: Modify details of an existing event or change its status (start, complete, cancel)

name: delete_guild_scheduled_event
description: Permanently delete a scheduled event

name: list_guild_scheduled_events
description: List all active and scheduled events on the server

params.name: withUserCount
params.description: Whether to include interested user count (default true)

name: get_guild_scheduled_event_users
description: Get list of users interested in a scheduled event

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of users to return (default 100)

params.name: withMember
params.description: Whether to include full member data with roles (default true)

name: list_active_threads
description: List all active threads in the server

name: get_user_id_by_name
description: Get a Discord user's ID by username in a guild for ping usage <@id>.

name: send_private_message
description: Send a private message to a specific user

name: edit_private_message
description: Edit a private message from a specific user

name: delete_private_message
description: Delete a private message from a specific user

name: read_private_messages
description: Read private message history from a specific user, optionally paginated with before/after/around

params.name: before
params.description: Message ID to fetch messages before this message

params.name: after
params.description: Message ID to fetch messages after this message

params.name: around
params.description: Message ID to fetch messages around this message

name: create_voice_channel
description: Create a new voice channel in a guild

params.name: bitrate
params.description: Audio bitrate in bits/s (e.g. 64000). Max depends on server boost level

name: create_stage_channel
description: Create a new stage channel for audio events in a guild

name: edit_voice_channel
description: Edit settings of a voice or stage channel (name, bitrate, user limit, region)

name: move_member
description: Move a member to another voice channel. The member must already be connected to a voice channel.

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the user to move

params.name: channelId
params.description: ID of the target voice channel

name: disconnect_member
description: Disconnect a member from their current voice channel

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the user to disconnect

name: modify_voice_state
description: Server mute or deafen a member across all voice channels. The member must be in a voice channel.

params.name: mute
params.description: Whether to server-mute the user's microphone

params.name: deafen
params.description: Whether to server-deafen the user's audio

name: create_webhook
description: Create a new webhook on a specific channel

name: delete_webhook
description: Delete a webhook

name: list_webhooks
description: List of webhooks on a specific channel

name: send_webhook_message
description: Send a message via webhook
